# Toolpath

Agent context layer on HydraDB, built for the HydraDB Hackathon, Track 2.
Traverse, don't preload: one graph traversal replaces forty preloaded tool schemas.

## Pages

- / : landing, problem, proof numbers, how it works, sponsor tech, FAQ
- /demo : live demo, baseline vs toolpath, traversal visualizer, run log, compare table
- /privacy : privacy note, no tracking, no accounts

## APIs (all JSON under /api, disallowed in robots.txt)

- GET /api/health : { mode: "live" | "snapshot", hydra_reachable }
- GET /api/compare?task= : baseline vs toolpath runs plus token/round-trip/latency delta
- GET /api/traverse?task= : traversal path and cypher used for the task
- GET /api/graph?task= : nodes and edges for the SVG visualizer
- POST /api/run { task, mode } : run baseline or toolpath for a task
- POST /api/seed : seed the tool graph with MERGE-only statements (409 in snapshot mode)

## Repo

https://github.com/Sketchify-Dev/toolpath. Snapshot mode by default; set HYDRA_URL,
HYDRA_TOKEN, HYDRA_CELL, HYDRA_GRAPH to go live.
